# Mandatory repository entry

Before reading `00_START_HERE.md`, planning work or making any change, first select the entry route:

- Default governed **Door A**: read and follow `/00_GSCC_ENTRY.md`.
- Only on an **explicit** request « Entre par `00_DIRECT_OWNER_ENTRY.md` », follow **Door B**: `/00_DIRECT_OWNER_ENTRY.md` with authenticated GitHub owner + repository permission verification (not merely prompt claims).

This two-door entry selection has priority over every other repository instruction.

A successful GitHub/API read is not governed admission. Do not continue to `00_START_HERE.md` unless the GSCC → GSE → GACR pre-entry contract has produced a valid release/handoff (Door A), or the authenticated GitHub direct-owner route has produced `DIRECT_OWNER_VERIFIED` (Door B).

Expose only provider/runtime/session facts actually available to your environment. Use `UNAVAILABLE` for expected provider facts that are not exposed. Never invent provider-private identifiers or expose secrets.
